title: Get approval for works to a State heritage item
what: Alter a registered place in a way that harms its heritage significance only under a development decision or works permit.

sources.title: Heritage Act 2018 (WA)
sources.quote: a person must not in, or in relation to, a registered place — (a) alter the fabric of the place or any part of, or thing in, the place so that the cultural heritage significance of the place is detrimentally affected;

sources.title: Heritage Act 2018 (WA)
sources.quote: Subsections (1), (2) and (3) do not apply to a person in respect of work that is authorised by — (a) a decision made in accordance with Part 5 Division 2; or (b) a works permit granted under section 79.

reach.condition: if it owns or works on an item on the State Heritage Register or under an interim heritage order
